whyItMatters: Without a Content-Security-Policy the browser has no allowlist for scripts, frames, or connections, so a single injection flaw runs with full page privileges.
actions: Send a Content-Security-Policy header starting from default-src 'self'.
Roll out in report-only mode first and triage violation reports before enforcing.
Re-run a passive DAST scan and confirm the header is observed on key responses.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes content-security-policy on the configured target.
